svg.title: Versioned sequence rendering without disturbing the v1 path
svg.desc: An architecture path from an owning PRD or Design Solution through source-contract selection. Existing system-diagram-v1 input stays on its frozen validator and renderer, while sequence v2 input passes through strict semantic validation, deterministic layout, and a same-style SVG renderer before both outputs reach version-aware report verification. Invalid v2 input returns a blocker.

text.tspan: Source order · integer geometry · no iteration
Checks source · provenance · exact renderer output
Reviewer sees one established visual language
